scope: Author-requested independent MAP01-MAP03 review beta, with existing modes and documented limitations; no public-store publication
authority: Recorded source/credit notices and the author's supplied project materials. This catalogue does not create a new third-party grant or convert author-reported provenance into independent ownership verification.

project-source.origin: Project-authored runtime code, configuration, dialogue, data, map geometry or generated metadata retained in the repository
project-source.permission: Author-directed project beta; LICENSE.md applies only to owned contributions

project-art.origin: Retained author-supplied or project-generated raster/mesh resources and their deterministic derivatives; exact per-file source metadata is attached where recorded
project-art.permission: Retain the documented project artwork for the author-requested beta; preserve separate source terms and author review qualifications

human-mesh.origin: Project meshes/animations/materials, including recorded MakeHuman hm08 CC0-derived body/head geometry
human-mesh.permission: Retain CC0 terms for upstream geometry; the project notice only covers owned additions

dejavu-font.origin: Retained DejaVu bitmap derivatives, plus the six missing authored characters added under #465
dejavu-font.permission: Bitstream Vera/DejaVu terms; retain notices and distinguish project font names from upstream trademarks

source-specific-audio.origin: 131 author-selected runtime recordings; individual aliases, source/credit locators and byte hashes are retained by #464
source-specific-audio.permission: Source-specific CC0, CC BY, Pixabay Content License or documented author/creator permission as recorded in the linked notices; no blanket relicensing

retained-notice.origin: Source-specific license, copyright and attribution notices retained with the associated material
retained-notice.permission: Preserve required attribution and legal wording; these notices do not transfer ownership to the project

excluded.commercial_iwads: Doom/Doom II and id24res WADs are development dependencies only; never include them
excluded.engine: GZDoom 4.14.2 and its installed support files are external, under the author's explicit distribution choice
excluded.tools: Python, Blender, FFmpeg, source fonts, generators and authoring references are not runtime package members
excluded.tests: Diagnostic IWAD/PK3 fixtures, saves, profiles, screenshots and logs remain outside the distributed game package
